purpose_context: Today WeaponArmorItem.damageBonus/armorRating are untyped numbers nothing consumes, and max HP/Mana are raw stored fields with no formula behind them. Players and the MJ expect equipping something like a +4 Mana Ring to visibly raise max mana on the sheet without a manual edit. This mission locks a structured bonus schema and the aggregation layer needed to make that true, per MIGRATION_BACKLOG.md's Cluster 1 sequencing.
purpose_tldr: Equipped weapons/armor items automatically raise or lower a character's computed stats (starting with max HP/Mana), instead of being flavor-only numbers no code reads.
